title: Related Products
content: Create related/recommended products section. Section header: "You May Also Like" or "Related Products". Layout: horizontal scroll row. Cards: compact product cards with image, name, price, quick add button. Carousel controls: left/right arrow buttons (hidden on mobile). Responsive: 2 visible on mobile, 4-6 on desktop. Loading: skeleton cards. Personalization: "Based on your browsing" if history available. Cross-sell: "Frequently bought together" with bundle option.

variants.simple: Create horizontal scroll row of related product cards.
variants.detailed: Create related/recommended products section. Section header: "You May Also Like" or "Related Products". Layout: horizontal scroll row. Cards: compact product cards with image, name, price, quick add button. Carousel controls: left/right arrow buttons (hidden on mobile). Responsive: 2 visible on mobile, 4-6 on desktop. Loading: skeleton cards. Personalization: "Based on your browsing" if history available. Cross-sell: "Frequently bought together" with bundle option.
variants.advanced: Create related/recommended products section with multiple display modes. Section container: py-12 with max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4. Section header: flex justify-between items-center mb-6. Title: "You May Also Like", "Related Products", "Customers Also Bought", or personalized "Based on Your Browsing" (text-2xl font-bold). "View All" link aligned right. Layout options: horizontal scroll row (default) or grid. Horizontal scroll: flex overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory gap-4 pb-4 -mx-4 px-4, hide scrollbar using scrollbar-hide utility or CSS. Each card: snap-center flex-shrink-0 w-[200px] or responsive width. Navigation arrows: absolute positioned ChevronLeft/ChevronRight buttons on sides, hidden on mobile (sm:flex), show only when scrollable (hide at scroll ends), circular bg-white shadow-lg hover:bg-gray-50 rounded-full p-2 buttons, z-10. Dot indicators: optional dots below carousel showing scroll position. Product cards: compact variant with image (aspect-square), product name (line-clamp-2), price, optional "Quick Add" button that appears on hover. Quick Add: adds to cart with default options, or opens quick view modal if variants needed. Product selection logic: based on same category, shared tags, purchase history, manual curation, or ML recommendation API. Personalization: if user history exists, show "Based on your browsing" with products from view history. "Recently Viewed" section: separate horizontal scroll showing products user recently looked at, stored in localStorage. Cross-sell variants: "Complete the Look" for fashion (styled outfit pieces), "Frequently Bought Together" showing bundle of 2-3 products with combined price and "Add All to Cart" button with discount. Responsive: show 2 cards on mobile viewport, 3-4 on tablet, 5-6 on desktop. Cards should be fully visible (no partial cards at edges, or half-visible to hint scrollability). Loading: skeleton cards matching card dimensions. Empty: hide section entirely if no related products. Tracking: track impressions and clicks on related products for analytics/ML training. Performance: lazy load images, defer rendering if below fold. Accessibility: carousel should be navigable via keyboard, announce slide changes.
